name: Hag, Storm (Mythic)
body:
Mythic Storm Hag
CR 8/MR 3

This hag’s hair, claws, and teeth crackle with sparks of electricity. Her windswept hair billows up from her brow like a thunderhead.

XP 3,200
CE Medium monstrous humanoid
Init +2; Senses child-scent, darkvision 60 ft., mistsight; Perception +14

DEFENSE

AC 25, touch 14, flat-footed 21 (+2 Dex, +2 dodge, +11 natural)
hp 115 (10d10+60)
Fort +6 Ref +9 Will +8
DR 5/epic; Immune electricity; SR 21

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft., fly 60 ft. (good)
Melee bite +13 (1d6+3 plus 1d6 electricity and 1d6 sonic), 2 claws +13 (1d4+3 plus 1d6 electricity and 1d6 sonic)
Special Attacks mythic power (3/day, surge 1d6), mythic spell-like abilities, storm strike, whipping winds
Simple Arcane Spellcasting (CL 10th, concentration +14)

5th—lightning arc (DC 21)
4th—solid fog
3rd—cloak of winds
2nd—fog cloud
1st—obscuring mist, shocking grasp

Spell-Like Abilities (CL 10th; concentration +14)

At will—bleed, gust of wind (DC 18), whispering wind
3/day—invisibility, empowered lightning bolt (DC 19), river of wind (DC 20), sleet storm
1/day—control winds (DC 19)

STATISTICS

Str 17, Dex 14, Con 16, Int 13, Wis 13, Cha 18
Base Atk +10; CMB +13; CMD 26
Feats Combat Casting, Dodge, Empower Spell-like Ability (lightning bolt), Flyby Attack, Spell FocusMF (evocation)
Skills Bluff +11, Fly +17, Intimidate +16, Perception +14, Spellcraft +7, Stealth +15
Languages Common, Giant
SQ storm rider

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Child-Scent (Ex)

A storm hag has the scent ability, but only with respect to humanoid children and immature animals. Thus, she could sniff out a child’s hiding place or a den of wolf pups, but not the child’s parents or the den mother.

Mythic Spell-Like Abilities (Su)

Three times per day, a mythic storm hag may use the mythic spell version of any of its corresponding spell-like abilities. She must expend the same amount of mythic power that would normally be required to cast a mythic spell, treating her mythic rank as her mythic tier for the purpose of qualifying to use augmented versions of mythic spells.

Storm Rider (Su)

A storm hag is considered two size categories larger for the purpose of wind effects.

Storm Strike (Su)

Each time a storm hag makes a successful attack with her bite, claws, or a weapon that is predominantly made of metal, the attack deals an additional 1d6 points of electricity damage and 1d6 points of sonic damage. On a critical hit, she can expend one use of mythic power to increase this to 2d6 of each damage type and cause the target to be blinded and deafened for 1 round. A successful DC 19 Fortitude save reduces this effect to dazzled for 1 round. The save DC is Charisma-based.

Whipping Winds (Su)

As a standard action, a storm hag can use gust of wind to trip her foes. This ability can only affect one target within 30 feet, and the storm hag uses her normal CMB. The gust of wind doesn’t create its normal effects. The trip attempt does not provoke an attack of opportunity, but casting the spell-like ability does as normal.

ECOLOGY

Environment any temperate
Organization solitary or coven (3 hags of any kind)
Treasure standard

When the clouds turn gray and the winds pick up into a howl, wise travelers pray that the cause is only a natural tempest and the foul weather is not connected with a storm hag. Storm hags are hateful creatures, and strangely, their hate is one of the few things that brings them pleasure.

Wiry and stooped, a storm hag weighs about 70 pounds and stands a little over 4 feet tall, though if she stood up straight she could easily reach 5 feet or more.
